resources.string: Connection
Cannot reach the server
The server did not answer. It may be switched off, or the address may be wrong.
Update
The server is updating
The server is updating to version %1$s. This takes a few minutes, and the app will carry on by itself.
The update failed
The update stopped after changing the database, so the server is stopped. Run this command on the server to go back to how it was before the update.
Server
Choose your server
Kvitteria runs on your own server. Enter the address of your household’s installation.
Server address
https://kvitteria.example.com
This is the same address you open Kvitteria on in a browser. https is assumed unless you say otherwise.
Connect
Change server
Enter a server address.
That does not look like an address. Try kvitteria.example.com.
Only http and https are supported.
Something answered at that address, but it was not a Kvitteria server.
Nothing answered at that address. Check that the server is running.
Enter the address only — /api and /auth/v1 belong to the server and are not part of it.
New server
No members yet
No members yet. The first account to sign in claims the household as admin.
As the admin you can give the rest of the household access, add mailboxes, and tune the pipeline.
Create the admin account
Sign in

Email
you@household.com
At least 8 characters
At least 8 characters. No confirmation email is sent — the account works right away.
Welcome back
Create your account
Sign in with the email your household gave access to.
Sign up with an email an admin has pre-authorized. If the household is brand new, the first account becomes its admin.
No access yet? Ask an admin to invite your email.
